_doc: Cross-node pod TCP failure. Every probe reads the one net-forensics capture ($NF, taken once) or one API read, so the race is ms. exit 0 = evidence for the hypothesis; exit 1 falsifies it. Any other exit (grep exit 2 on a missing capture, an unreachable API) is UNKNOWN: evidence unavailable, never a result. fix = the estate intent that repairs it; verify = the intent that proves the repair.

hypotheses.statement: orphaned FLANNEL-POSTRTG MASQUERADE SNATs cross-node pod traffic
rp_filter=1 on all/overlay drops asymmetric overlay packets
conntrack table >= 80% full drops new flows
a FAILED/INCOMPLETE neighbour blackholes the next hop
GlobalNetworkPolicy deny-direct-ai-vendor-egress selects all() with type Egress: default-denies egress of every pod without its own allow
hypotheses.probe: s=$(kubectl --request-timeout=10s get globalnetworkpolicy deny-direct-ai-vendor-egress --ignore-not-found -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}{.spec.types}' 2>/dev/null) || exit 2; [ "$s" = 'all()["Egress"]' ]
